BisectHosting
Web Developer
Remote
Entry Level
BisectHosting is seeking a Web Developer (SDE1) to build and improve customer-facing and internal web applications across its hosting platform. The role focuses on frontend development with React and Nuxt/Vue, backend contributions using PHP Laravel, growth engineering, experimentation, integrations, performance, accessibility, and issue resolution.
Qualifications
Strong experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and React, Vue, or Nuxt
Experience developing backend applications and APIs using PHP Laravel
Comfortable working with experimentation and production issue resolution
